# Openfolio: AI portfolio builder

> {{ promise }}

Source: {{ public_url }}/llms-full.txt. Short version: {{ public_url }}/llms.txt.

## In one sentence

Openfolio is an open-source AI portfolio builder that gives anyone a 3D AI version of themselves that answers recruiters' questions about their work, by voice or chat, using only what they wrote.

## Names

- Openfolio is the product and the open-source project. Openfolio Cloud is the hosted service.
- Tagline: "{{ tagline }}"

## What it does

- A visitor opens the owner's portfolio and taps Talk or Chat.
- A 3D avatar answers by voice, with live captions and lip-sync, or by text. Typing never asks for the microphone.
- Answers come only from the owner's profile: about, highlights, experience, projects, skills, education, links and the rules the owner sets.
- Project, experience, skill and contact cards appear in the chat.
- Visitors can leave their name, email and a message for the owner.
- When a question is not covered, it says it doesn't know and suggests contacting the real person.

## Who it is for

- Students and new graduates applying for internships and first jobs.
- Engineers who want hiring managers to hear about their systems, trade-offs and results.
- Designers who want each case study to come with its reasoning.
- Freelancers who want client questions answered while they work.
- Career switchers who want to connect past roles with the job they want next.
- Recruiters and hiring managers, who can interview a candidate's AI twin at any time.

## How Openfolio Cloud works

1. Join the waitlist at {{ public_url }}/#request. A person reads every request; approved people get a personal invite link by email.
2. Upload your résumé and a photo.
3. Openfolio drafts your AI's profile from them.
4. Review and edit every fact, add rules such as "never discuss salary", and choose a 3D avatar. Nothing is shared until you approve it.
5. Share a link, or paste one script tag into your own site.

Status: invite-only beta. New members are admitted from the waitlist a few at a time.

## Safety and honesty

- Always labelled AI: the launcher button, the panel and the first answer say it is an AI version of the owner, and it says so whenever asked whether it is human.
- Facts come only from the owner's profile. Its instructions forbid inventing employers, dates, numbers, salaries or commitments.
- Messages are screened for prompt injection before they reach the model, and answers stay on the owner's work.
- It runs only on websites the owner lists.
- The owner can pause it at any time and delete their content.
- Openfolio Cloud does not save recordings or transcripts. Visitors get no cookies or trackers.
- Calls have time limits, turn limits and per-network rate limits.

## Pricing

- Openfolio Cloud is free during the invite-only beta.
- Founding members: people who join the waitlist during the beta get free monthly credits.
- Contributors: people whose pull requests are merged get extra credits.
- Self-hosting is free under Apache-2.0. You pay your own AI providers, or nothing with local models.

## Technology

- Server: Python with FastAPI and Pipecat (a real-time voice pipeline) over WebRTC. No GPU is needed, because the 3D face renders in the visitor's browser.
- Widget: a TypeScript web component (<openfolio-agent>) using three.js, TalkingHead and HeadAudio lip-sync. The loader script is about 11 KB (4 KB gzipped) and loads the rest only when a visitor opens it. Shadow DOM keeps the host site's CSS untouched.
- Providers: any OpenAI-compatible language model (OpenAI, Groq, OpenRouter, Ollama, vLLM); Deepgram or local Whisper for speech-to-text; Kokoro (free, runs on CPU) or ElevenLabs for the voice.
- Embed code: <script src="https://YOUR-SERVER/embed/embed.js" data-persona="you" async></script>

## Limits

- AI can be wrong. Owners should review their profile, and visitors should confirm important details (dates, offers, availability) with the person.
- Voice needs microphone permission; text chat does not.
- Openfolio Cloud is a beta run by one person, so features may change.
